title: Site event blocks compare against the Space's own day, not the UTC day

verify.note: Fails before the fix: freeHumanToday does not exist and today comes from toISOString.

detail: freeHumanUpcoming and freeHumanOccurrences used now.toISOString().slice(0,10), the UTC day, against stored wall-clock dates. After about 5pm Pacific the day flips and the evening's gatherings leave the upcoming list and the Calendar block hours early (same class as SCAN-1037 and SCAN-1126). Fixed for the Free Human helpers with the Space's zone (America/Los_Angeles). The Nocturne, Temple, Network, Roles, Free Human calendar and wheel blocks now call siteToday (Pacific). A per-Space timezone is a later refinement; the sites launch in one region.
